resources.string:
This app is only the game engine. To play, you need the data files from your own copy of Descent II for PC (for example from GOG or Steam):

descent2.hog, descent2.ham, descent2.s22 (or descent2.s11), alien1.pig, alien2.pig, fire.pig, groupa.pig, ice.pig, water.pig

Movies (*.mvl) are optional. Copy the game folder to this device and pick it below; subfolders are searched too.
This Android version cannot pick a folder. Copy the files over USB into:\n%1$s\nthen tap \"Check again\".
Not enough free space: %1$d MB needed
